# Evaluation Verdict

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:EvaluationVerdict`](gmeow-EvaluationVerdict.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/EvaluationVerdict>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The outcome of a condition evaluation — held, not held, or undetermined. A closed three-member value vocabulary. Semantically the [`observationResult`](../properties/gmeow-observationResult.md) of a [`ConditionEvaluation`](gmeow-ConditionEvaluation.md), but not declared [rdfs:subPropertyOf-reachable](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf-reachable) because QualityValues are disjoint from Entities in the DL profile (the [`claimModality`](../properties/gmeow-claimModality.md) precedent, standpoint module).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:EvaluationVerdict`](gmeow-EvaluationVerdict.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the closed value vocabulary for evaluation outcomes — held, not held, undetermined — reused by both [`gmeow:evaluationVerdict`](../properties/gmeow-evaluationVerdict.md) and [`gmeow:complianceVerdict`](../properties/gmeow-complianceVerdict.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a fourth verdict (the trichotomy is closed) and avoid modelling it as an [`observationResult`](../properties/gmeow-observationResult.md) subproperty — QualityValue is disjoint from [`Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md) (the [`claimModality`](../properties/gmeow-claimModality.md) pattern).

### How to use

- Reference one of the three seeded verdict individuals from an evaluation or compliance assessment; undetermined is a first-class outcome, not an absence.

### Examples

- ex:ev1 [`gmeow:evaluationVerdict`](../properties/gmeow-evaluationVerdict.md) [`gmeow:verdictUndetermined`](../individuals/gmeow-verdictUndetermined.md).
